rationale: The Latin anchor *separare* and the Gospel quotation "veni separare hominem adversus patrem suum" (Mt. 10:35, "I came to set a man against his father") point firmly to the sense of separating/setting apart persons or relationships, not physical cutting. This matches sever.v.01 ("set or keep apart") rather than the literal bodily severance of discerp.v.02.
